title: Investor / Capital-Raising Proposal
purpose: Present an investable opportunity, capital requirement, risk profile and plausible path to value without disguising uncertainty.

sections.title: Investment Summary
sections.instruction: State company/project, raise amount, instrument, stage, use of proceeds, current traction and proposed next milestone.

sections.title: Customer Problem and Market Need
sections.instruction: Show customer segment, urgency, current workaround, willingness-to-pay evidence and market evidence.

sections.title: Product and Technical Solution
sections.instruction: Describe product, architecture, differentiation, IP, maturity, demo evidence and roadmap. Label simulated vs deployed capability.

sections.title: Market and Competition
sections.instruction: Define TAM/SAM/SOM with reproducible method, geography, segment, source and assumptions. Compare direct, indirect and substitute competitors.

sections.title: Business Model and Go-to-Market
sections.instruction: Pricing, sales channel, procurement cycle, customer acquisition, deployment, service, retention and revenue recognition assumptions.

sections.title: Traction and Validation
sections.instruction: Separate signed contracts, paid pilots, LOIs, interviews, waitlists, usage, lab tests and simulations. Never represent an LOI as revenue.

sections.title: Unit Economics and Financial Model
sections.instruction: Derive BOM, labor, manufacturing, service, warranty, logistics, gross margin, CAC, LTV and working capital from traceable inputs.

sections.title: Team and Governance
sections.instruction: Verified experience, roles, ownership, hiring plan, board/governance and key-person risk.

sections.title: Milestones and Capital Plan
sections.instruction: Use of proceeds by work package, runway, stage gates, next financing dependency and measurable milestones.

sections.title: Risks and Mitigations
sections.instruction: Technical, market, regulatory, supply chain, manufacturing, execution, financing and IP risks.

sections.title: The Ask and Terms
sections.instruction: Amount, instrument, valuation/terms if determined, tranches, conditions, timing and contact.

sections.title: Due-Diligence Appendix
sections.instruction: Financial model, cap table, IP schedule, customer evidence, technical architecture, test reports, regulatory map and data room index.
